summary: Frontend-only mobile (390x844) regression as Owner baa. I logged in with the API token, stubbed window.open and created no data. The iteration-25 border fix is VERIFIED. On operations-table (all 4 views), report-products-table, menu-stock-history and pos-dashboard-history, the outer .bento-scrollable::before is display:none and the wrapper border is the neutral rgb(39,39,42). The inner table.table-x has border-collapse: separate and a 1px border-image gradient, and the orange border is visible in element screenshots. Pixel sampling confirms it: the bento wrapper edges have 0 orange pixels, while the table edges have orange pixels (the left edge is ~100% orange; the right edge is off-screen until scrolled, as expected). Horizontal scroll works (scrollLeft 112-200 on overflowing tables). The operations empty state renders inside the bordered table as a colSpan row, is fully readable and has no clipping. Excel/PDF/Cetak/Kirim WA sit above the DateFilter in all 4 views (buttons top 117px, date-filter top 161px; inventory has no DateFilter). The WA message opens wa.me with the title, total and up to 10 detail rows (inventory: 27 records, 10 bullets). FAIL: the inventory WA message still shows the date range ('📅 2026-10-22 → 2026-10-22') and never says 'snapshot'. No console errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Inventory WA message always shows the line '📅 ${range.start} → ${range.end}' and never mentions a snapshot. The requirement says inventory should say snapshot, not a date range.

issues: The empty state 'Belum ada produk terjual pada periode ini' renders outside/below the orange table border because <Empty> is a sibling of the table. Move it into a tbody colSpan row, as done for operations.
On mobile the empty text 'Belum ada penjualan pada periode ini.' is centered in a 38rem (608px) table and clipped at the 356px viewport. The user must scroll to read it.
With no movements the table shows only headers and no empty-state message.

action_items: In Reports.jsx sendOperationsWhatsApp, for kind === 'inventory' replace the date-range line with a snapshot line, e.g. '📦 Snapshot per <today/now>'.
Optional: move the report-products-table empty state inside the table (tbody row with colSpan=4).
Optional: make the empty state on the pos-dashboard-history and menu-stock-history tables readable without scrolling, and add an empty row to menu-stock-history.
critical_code_review_comments: In Reports.jsx line 292, the WA template ignores kind for the date line, so inventory gets a misleading range.
The border-image under border-collapse: separate gives square corners on the table; the rounded look of the bento wrapper is lost. This is acceptable but cosmetic.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (11/12 checks; inventory WA snapshot wording failed)

Put the token in localStorage (si4am_token, si4am_legal_2026-06-01=accepted, si4am_session_wib_date=WIB date). Stub window.open with add_init_script. PIL works inside the browser_automation tool: take an element screenshot of the table.table-x and count orange edge pixels (r>150, r-b>60). The bento wrapper should show 0 orange pixels. Only open item: the inventory WA snapshot wording.
